description: OpenAI Codex CLI as a long-running resident engine node — `r4t engine codex run --resident`, keeping one `codex app-server` thread with the `a8s_tell` MCP server alive while it works and for `TIMEOUT` seconds of quiet after the last turn (default 2700, 45 minutes), sending new messages into the same conversation one turn at a time and wrapping up STATUS.md/LESSONS.md at expiry; the next message after that starts a fresh session from STATUS.md. The session runs in the workspace-write sandbox with approvals never and refuses to start when app-server reports any other policy; on Linux that sandbox needs unprivileged user namespaces for bubblewrap, or every shell command in a turn fails. `r4t engine codex check --resident` proves the policy and names the app-server version. `a8s stop`, `restart` and `kill` end the session at once through `stop.invoke`; `status.invoke` lets `a8s ps` show busy or resident. Enable private K7E memory with `a8s vars <name> set MEMORY on`. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means the engine's own default. Set the quiet window per node with `a8s vars <name> set TIMEOUT <secs>`. Set EFFORT to an engine-supported reasoning level; unset uses the engine default. Commit as the agent with `a8s vars <name> set GIT_NAME ...` and `GIT_EMAIL ...`; unset uses git's own config.
